title: Slides a piece straight to a new place
looks: The piece glides in a straight line from where it is to the target and stays there.
use: A card or token changes zone: drawn, played, moved on the board.

title: Flies a piece in an arc
looks: The piece rises in an arc and lands on the target, optionally banking and leaning as it flies.
use: A card is tossed, dealt or thrown to a zone.

title: Flies a piece through several stops and back
looks: The piece launches, circles each stop in turn with fading ghosts behind it, and returns home.
use: A ship or unit visits several places in one action, then comes back.

title: Raises a piece up off the table
looks: The piece rises a few pixels, grows slightly and casts a deeper shadow, and stays raised.
use: A card is picked up, chosen or about to be played.

title: Sets a raised piece back down
looks: The piece drops from a raised pose, dips just under its size and comes to rest with a flat shadow.
use: A lifted card is put down or lands after a move.

title: Turns a card over by squashing it flat
looks: The card narrows to an edge, swaps to its other face and widens again.
use: A card is revealed, turned face down or switches side.

title: Turns a card over in 3D
looks: The card rotates in perspective to edge-on, swaps faces at the edge and turns flat again, with optional overshoot and glow.
use: A dramatic reveal of a card face.

title: Grows or shrinks a piece to a size
looks: The piece scales smoothly to the given size and stays at it.
use: A card is enlarged to read or shrunk away.

title: Swells a piece once and back
looks: The piece grows to the size and returns to rest in one beat.
use: Draw the eye to a piece that just changed.

title: Spins a piece round a number of turns
looks: The piece rotates the given turns about its centre; whole turns end where it started.
use: A coin, die or token spins.

title: Keeps a piece spinning until the step ends
looks: The piece turns round and round at a steady period, then snaps back to its resting angle.
use: A token is busy or charging for a while.

title: Turns a card sideways to show it used
looks: The card rotates a quarter turn, optionally overshooting, and stays turned.
use: A card is exhausted, tapped or used this round.

title: Turns a sideways card upright again
looks: A rotated card turns back to upright and stays upright.
use: A card is readied or refreshed.

title: Shrinks to a point and reappears elsewhere
looks: The piece collapses into a flash with streaks, holds, and bursts back open at the target.
use: A piece teleports or jumps across the board.

title: Carries a token between two columns of light
looks: A column of light rises at the source carrying the token up, and a second column sets it down at the target with sparks.
use: A resource or token is sent from one place to another.

title: Sends a line of light dots between places
looks: A band of light with travelling dots crosses from the source to the target; the token itself stays.
use: Show a link or a flow between two zones.

title: Zips a token across leaving afterimages
looks: The token streaks to the target with ghost copies behind it and pops with a small burst of sparks on landing.
use: A fast gain or transfer of a token.

title: Raises a token then flies it straight
looks: The token rises off its place, then travels straight to the target.
use: A token is collected and carried to a pool.

title: Sucks a token through a spinning vortex
looks: A spinning vortex opens, the token spirals in and shrinks, and comes out at the target.
use: A piece is banished, summoned or sent through a gate.

title: Pops an icon into view in place
looks: The icon appears small, overshoots its size and settles.
use: A new icon or token is revealed where it stands.

title: Greys out a piece in place
looks: The piece fades to a dim, desaturated look and stays that way.
use: A piece is spent, disabled or unavailable.

title: Bumps a counter as it changes
looks: The counter jumps up and back with a coloured flash of its digits.
use: A number on the board goes up or down.

title: Spirals a ship out with an engine trail
looks: The ship banks round in a squashed orbit and spirals away or in, a glowing engine ribbon behind it.
use: A ship departs to or returns from a place off the board.

title: Fades a piece into view
looks: The piece goes from transparent to fully visible.
use: Something appears: a new card, a panel, a token.

title: Fades in large and shrinks into place
looks: The piece appears at twice its size and shrinks down to normal as it becomes solid.
use: A piece arrives with weight: a placed marker, a summoned unit.

title: Fades a piece out of view
looks: The piece goes from fully visible to transparent (or to the given opacity).
use: Something leaves: a discarded card, a closed panel.

title: Shows a piece at once
looks: The piece becomes visible instantly, with no motion.
use: Reveal a stand-in or a final state between steps.

title: Hides a piece at once
looks: The piece disappears instantly, with no motion.
use: Remove a stand-in or a piece between steps.

title: Unrolls a panel open from one edge
looks: The panel grows from a line at its edge to full size along one axis.
use: A banner, scroll, table or briefing panel opens.

title: Collapses a panel to a glowing line
looks: The panel squeezes to a thin line that can glow and flicker, then goes out.
use: A panel or screen closes like an old monitor.

title: Unrolls a banner, shows text, fades away
looks: A strip unrolls, its text appears in the middle, holds, and the whole banner fades out.
use: Announce a round, a phase or an event.

title: Fades in text rising into place
looks: A line of text fades in while rising a little and stays.
use: A label, a word of result or a caption appears.

title: Types out text word by word
looks: The text reveals itself a word or a letter at a time over the step.
use: Narration, a briefing or a story line.

title: Counts a number up to its new value
looks: A number on the piece rolls from the start value to the target, easing out.
use: A score, total or resource changes.

title: Makes a piece glow once
looks: A soft halo grows around the piece and fades back.
use: Draw attention to a piece: a target, a trigger, a choice.

title: Lights a piece and keeps it lit
looks: A halo grows round the piece and stays until a later glow step releases it.
use: A piece stays selected or active across several steps.

title: Dims a lit piece to dark
looks: The piece starts lit with a halo and dims until the glow is gone.
use: A piece loses power or is switched off.

title: Shakes a piece side to side
looks: The piece jitters left and right a few times and returns to rest.
use: A hit, a refusal or an invalid move.

title: Shakes several pieces together
looks: The listed pieces (or page elements) jitter at once with small offsets in both directions.
use: An explosion or quake rattles a whole area.

title: Draws a fading ribbon behind a flight
looks: A tapering ribbon of light follows the curved path of a flying piece and fades out.
use: Give a flying card or ship a visible wake.

title: Bursts streaks of light from a point
looks: Thin coloured streaks shoot out from (or rush into) a centre point and fade.
use: Power gathering or released at a spot.

title: Raises a column of light over a piece
looks: A vertical column of light with a core and drifting glitter rises over the piece and fades.
use: A piece arrives, is beamed down or powered up.

title: Curves a beam of light to a target
looks: A glowing beam bends from the piece to the target along a curve, with motes and sparks.
use: A piece sends power or a unit to another place.

title: Sweeps a turning wedge of light round
looks: A wedge of light turns round the piece like a lighthouse, then fades.
use: A scan, a search or a radar sweep.

title: Fires a steady beam at another piece
looks: A beam with a bright head shoots from the source, holds on the target with a flickering spot, then fades.
use: An attack or a ray from one piece to another.

title: Shoots a fast bolt with a tail
looks: A short bright bolt with a tapering tail streaks from the source and flashes on the target.
use: A shot or missile is fired.

title: Shoots a curved shot with a trail
looks: A shot arcs from the source to the target trailing a curved ribbon and fades.
use: A lobbed or homing shot.

title: Heats up, breaks apart, embers rise
looks: The card glows hot from one point, breaks into small squares, and embers drift up.
use: A card or piece is destroyed.

title: Burns away into rising smoke
looks: The card burns apart while its pieces lift, spin and fade into smoke.
use: A piece is destroyed and leaves no trace.

title: Shatters a piece into flying shards
looks: The piece breaks into triangular shards that glow hot, fly apart and cool as they fall.
use: A piece is smashed or destroyed by a blow.

title: Ripples a shimmer where a hit lands
looks: An oval shimmer flashes over the piece and a ring ripples out from the hit point.
use: A hit is absorbed or deflected.

title: Sends a ring outward from a piece
looks: A ring outlines the piece and expands and fades, once or a few times.
use: Mark a piece that triggered or a spot that matters.

title: Blasts shockwave rings out from an impact
looks: Wide rings burst outward from the piece, thinning and fading as they grow.
use: An explosion or a heavy impact.

title: Flashes a hex shield as a hit lands
looks: A bubble of hexagon cells lights round the piece and waves spread from the hit angle.
use: An attack is blocked by a shield.

title: Breaks a hex shield into pieces
looks: The hexagon bubble lights on the hit, cracks and scatters away.
use: A shield is broken.

title: Builds a hex shield up cell by cell
looks: Hexagon cells assemble round the piece, hum and settle as a scan sweeps across.
use: A shield is raised or recharged.

title: Stamps a label onto a piece
looks: A tilted label slams down onto the piece from larger to its size and stays on it.
use: Mark a result: done, won, lost, claimed.

title: Stamps a cracked label onto a piece
looks: A label slams down and a jagged crack appears across it at the press.
use: Mark a failure or a broken result.

title: Floats small lights up from a piece
looks: Small glowing dots drift up from the piece and fade at different heights.
use: Gentle gain: healing, a resource, a blessing.

title: Flickers a coloured light over a piece
looks: A coloured overlay breathes on and off over the piece a few times.
use: A piece is unstable, warned or under an effect.

title: Buzzes a piece like a bad signal
looks: The piece jitters and its brightness and colour flicker in noisy bursts.
use: A piece is damaged, glitching or losing power.

title: Fills a bar from one level to another
looks: A bar inside the piece grows or shrinks between two fractions, with an optional hopping marker.
use: A track, meter or progress value changes.

title: Moves a numbered pin along a track
looks: A numbered marker lifts, slides along the track by the change and lands with a glow and a ring.
use: A score marker moves on a track.

title: Clears a used card back to ready
looks: The card's banner lifts off and a grey copy drains away bottom to top, leaving the ready face.
use: A used or exhausted card becomes ready again.

title: Pulses a piece in a steady rhythm
looks: The piece repeats a short change (by default its opacity) every period until the step ends.
use: A piece waits for the player: playable, pending, active.

title: Bobs a piece gently up and down
looks: The piece floats up a few pixels and back, over and over.
use: A piece is alive and waiting: a hovering ship, a lit token.

title: Breathes a piece softly in and out
looks: The piece slowly fades a little and back, over and over.
use: A quiet sign that a piece is active.

title: Circles little stars round a piece
looks: Small stars orbit in an ellipse above the piece, twinkling, optionally crackling.
use: A piece is stunned, dazed or enchanted.

title: Drifts a piece slowly away and back
looks: The piece moves slowly to an offset and size and returns, over a long period.
use: A background picture or panel lives quietly.

title: Draws a marching dashed line between pieces
looks: A dashed line joins two pieces, its dashes running from one to the other.
use: Show a link, a target or a path between two pieces.

title: Closes target brackets in on a piece
looks: Four corner brackets close in around the piece and fade.
use: A piece is targeted or chosen.

title: Throws small pieces out that fall
looks: Small fragments burst out from the piece, spin and fall with gravity, then fade.
use: Something breaks, explodes or is hit hard.

title: Sweeps a band of light across a piece
looks: A slanted shine slides across the piece from one side to the other.
use: A card is new, rare, chosen or upgraded.

title: Fizzles a piece out with grey static
looks: The piece shakes, turns grey and a noisy sputter crosses it.
use: An action fails or a card is cancelled.

title: Bursts sparks out from a piece
looks: A spray of sparks flies out of the middle of the piece and fades.
use: A success, a completion or a reward.

title: Slashes strokes across a piece
looks: One or more bright strokes cut across the piece and fade.
use: A melee hit or a claw attack.

title: Crumples a card into a ball, throws it
looks: The card folds into a creased ball in 3D, then is tossed and lands at the target.
use: A card is discarded or thrown away.

title: Glitches a logo with split colour bursts
looks: Every few seconds the wordmark splits into two colours, slices jump sideways and a frame drops out.
use: A title or logo that feels alive, or a victory or defeat tear.

title: Zooms the board in and dims around it
looks: The whole board scales up about a point while a shade darkens the edges, then eases back.
use: A dramatic moment: a big attack, a game-changing card.

title: Pushes the camera in and back
looks: The board scales in slightly about a focus point and returns to normal, optionally with shake.
use: An impact or emphasis on one area.

title: Slides in cinema bars with a caption
looks: Black bars slide in top and bottom with a vignette and a caption, then slide out.
use: A cut-scene feel: a closing scene, an ending.

title: Draws a crackling orb of energy
looks: A glowing ball with arcs, filaments and motes pulses and swells.
use: A power source, a charge or a magic core.

title: Drifts broken card shards across the screen
looks: Triangle shards of artwork float, spin and fade with embers, in waves.
use: A closing or ruined scene: what is left of the board.

title: Lifts a pile while a card flies off
looks: The live pile rises with a shadow, holds, and settles when the game says the card arrived.
use: A card is drawn from a deck or pile.

title: Flies a card between screens smoothly
looks: The card moves from an overlay to its board place with the browser's view transition.
use: A card leaves a dialog and lands on the board.

title: Pulses a live page element until stopped
looks: A page element repeats a short change every period until the game stops it.
use: A playable card or button waits, outside any beat.

title: Keeps a live element bobbing or orbiting
looks: A page element bobs, breathes, drifts or carries orbiting stars until the game stops it.
use: An idle piece on the board, outside any beat.

title: Counts a number up in the game's text
looks: A number in the game's own element rolls up to its value, easing out.
use: A score or total in the game's UI changes.

title: Shows banner lines one after another
looks: Lines of a banner appear one every 650 ms, the newest fading and scaling in.
use: Several events announced in turn.

title: Shakes the screen harder for bigger hits
looks: The view jolts and wobbles with a strength that grows with the damage and fades quickly.
use: A hit lands; a kill shakes harder.
